'''Myrrack''' was a renowned [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] artist. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was tasked with repairing the [[Dro ceremonial fountain]], unknowingly saving it from [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]].
